name: android_multitouch_gesture
description: Real multi-finger touch (up to 10 fingers at once, millisecond timing) for games and maps. gesture "strokes": each stroke is one finger following its points [{x, y, t}] (t = ms from the start; one point = a tap held holdMs), e.g. hold a joystick with one finger while another taps a button. gesture "pinch" zooms by scale (> 1 in, < 1 out); "rotate" turns by angleDegrees (> 0 clockwise). Coordinates are screen fractions when within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels of the current orientation. Uses a scrcpy control session (started on first use, about 1-2 s); pinch and rotate fall back to a one-finger approximation without it.

scale.description: Pinch: zoom factor, e.g. 1.5 in or 0.5 out.

radius.description: Rotate: finger distance from the center (default 200 px).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
